headline: Sensex Rises Over 400 Points, Nifty Near 23,400 as Crude Oil Prices Ease

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Crude oil prices eased by over 2.5%, providing a boost to Indian equities.
Inflow of foreign funds provided support to benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty.
Strong buying momentum in key sectors such as Nifty Pharma, which rose over 1%.
Positive performance from large-cap gainers like Sun Pharma and HCL Tech.
whatHappening: Sensex surged over 400 points while Nifty traded above the 23,350 mark.
Welspun Corp jumped 5% following a Rs 2,000 crore order win from Saudi Aramco.
Tata Chemicals and Tata Investment Corp fell up to 3% amid ongoing boardroom dispute news.
Gold prices dropped Rs 1,331 per 10 grams and silver fell Rs 1,600 per kg.
summary:
Indian benchmark indices opened on a strong note on September 21, with the Sensex rising over 400 points and Nifty holding above 23,350.
A decline of over 2.5% in crude oil prices and gains in pharma and tech stocks boosted market sentiment.
Welspun Corp surged on a massive order win, whereas Tata group stocks Tata Chemicals and Tata Investment Corp saw declines.
